profile.name: 光束挡板
profile.description: 用于束线或实验光路中的插入/移出式挡板设备。该类设备通过外部控制信号执行打开与关闭，并结合进位/退位限位开关判断当前位置；部分变体仅提供状态读取，用于光路联锁显示与通光状态判断。
profile.description_en: An insertable/removable beamline stopper used in experimental beam paths. It is opened and closed via external control signals, and its position is determined from in/out limit switches; some variants are status-only and are used for lightpath display and transmission-state evaluation.

registry.name: Beam Stopper/Shutter
registry.description: Beam Stopper/Shutter是一款表征设备，主要功能包括关闭、打开。支持Signal, Slot, calc lightpath state等操作。
